Hodges, R. and Hawkes, A. (AEA Technology plc) (2010). Analysing the Opportunities for Abatement in Major Emitting Industrial Sectors. Report for the Committee on Climate Change, AEAT/ENV/R/Industrial Energy Efficiency, ED56369, Issue Number 1, 8 December 2010. https://www.theccc.org.uk/archive/aws2/4th%20Budget/Final%20Report%20ED56369.pdf

Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 6; e.g. Table 1 printed p.35 = PDF p.41). The report is a sector MACC study: per-measure energy and cost inputs were in the AEA Excel model, which the report does not print. Main file (6 technologies): the few per-unit technology figures in the text - sulpho-aluminate clinker process CO2 0.22 vs OPC 0.52 t/t clinker, ORC on a cement clinker cooler (1 MW net, 97% availability, Lengfurt), air bottoming cycle up to 26% heat-to-power, nitric acid N2O 5 (2-9) kg/t and 1.49 t CO2e/t, and the chlor-alkali hydrogen fuel cell (description and maturity only). _measures.csv: all 36 opportunities of Table 1 with central EAC of abatement (GBP/tCO2) and the low/high cases in the note, plus the % savings the sector text gives, and two product-substitution measures. TRAPS: (1) Table 1 appears to print the NEGATIVE of the abatement cost (TGRBF printed -49 while text says +GBP 50/t; whole refinery optimisation printed +96 but described as negative-cost); loaded as printed and flagged. (2) Low/central/high columns are not monotonic. (3) No price year stated (2010 assumed). (4) The cover says ED56369 but the running header says ED56379. _other-values.csv: clinker ratio, kiln counts, plant sizes, discount rates, sector baselines and abatement potentials (App. 1 and 3). Not loaded: MACC charts (figures), scenario tables by year, devolved administration splits (App. 5), steel re-use estimates (App. 4).
